definition: a painful or horrific experience, especially a protracted one
hook: An ordeal used to be a trial with a verdict written in fire.
modernAnchor: Now it just means a bad week at the DMV. Back then, it could kill you.
journey: Medieval courts sometimes settled guilt by ordal, an old English word simply meaning judgment.
The accused might carry hot iron or plunge a hand into boiling water to prove innocence.
If the wound healed clean within days, God had spoken, and the person walked free.
The fire and water faded from law, but the suffering stayed behind in the word.
